_note: Player-facing skill descriptions (written for this game). Shown on the Skills screen.

skills.berserk: Fly into a rage: heal a little and hit harder and more accurately for a while.
skills.warcry: A battle shout that raises your accuracy and damage for 8 turns.
skills.charge: Rush an enemy up to 4 tiles away and open with a heavy blow. Best with a sword. Only on enemies above a third of their HP.
skills.bash: Shoulder-slam an enemy: damage and a chance to knock it down for a turn.
skills.trip: Sweep an enemy's legs: knocks it down for a turn and deals a little damage.
skills.dirt kicking: Kick dirt in an enemy's eyes: blinds it for 2 turns, making it miss far more.
skills.kick: A quick kick for light damage. Short cooldown, always useful.
skills.envenom: Coat your weapon in poison for 6 turns: your hits poison enemies.
skills.backstab: A brutal opening strike from the shadows. Best with a dagger. Only on enemies above a third of their HP.
skills.circle: Slip around an enemy mid-fight and stab it in the back. Best with a dagger.
skills.toss daggers: Throw a dagger at an enemy up to 5 tiles away.
skills.gouge: Go for the eyes: blinds an enemy for 3 turns.
skills.sanctuary: A holy ward that halves all damage you take for a few turns.
skills.shield: A shimmering shield that improves your armor for 12 turns.
skills.haste: Speed yourself up: you act more often for a while.
skills.armor: A protective spell that improves your armor for 12 turns.
skills.sleep: Put an enemy to sleep for 2 turns (it may resist). Damage wakes it.
skills.chain lightning: Lightning that jumps between enemies near you, weaker with each jump.
skills.implosion: Crush one enemy with a heavy blast of force (range 5).
skills.slow: Slow an enemy down so it acts less often (it may resist).
skills.magic fist: A cheap punch of raw magic at range 6. Your bread-and-butter spell.
skills.storm of blades: A whirling flurry of blades that hits every enemy next to you, with bonus swings.
skills.whirlwind: Spin and strike every enemy next to you.
skills.transfix: Lock eyes with an enemy and stun it for 1 to 3 turns, then strike.
skills.blinding strike: A slash across the eyes that blinds an enemy for 2 turns.
skills.cross slash: Two-bladed slash that opens a fight with heavy damage. Needs two weapons.
